<solution_file path="outputs/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# Read input data
input_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'
output_clusters_path = 'outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv'
output_profiles_path = 'outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv'

df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify numeric columns for clustering (exclude identifiers)
identifier_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
numeric_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in identifier_cols and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col])]

# Create working copy for scaling
df_scaled = df.copy()

# Median imputation on numeric columns
median_values = df[numeric_cols].median()
df_scaled = df_scaled.fillna(median_values)

# Standard scaling (z-score)
scaler = StandardScaler()
df_scaled[numeric_cols] = scaler.fit_transform(df_scaled[numeric_cols])

# Apply KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(df_scaled[numeric_cols])

# Create output dataframe with cluster assignment
df_clusters = df.copy()
df_clusters['cluster_id'] = cluster_labels

# Write city clusters output
df_clusters.to_csv(output_clusters_path, index=False)

# Compute cluster profiles using raw values (before imputation/scaling)
# Group by cluster and compute mean of raw indicator values (non-missing only)
cluster_profiles = df.groupby(cluster_labels)[numeric_cols].mean()

# Write cluster profiles output
cluster_profiles.to_csv(output_profiles_path, index=False)
